items.name: The Include Aisle
items.depicts: Two towering five-shelf wooden bookcases packed with gold-banded volumes, flanking a rolling ladder suspended from an overhead rail.

items.name: Static Binder
items.depicts: A grey iron screw press with a side gear wheel lowering a platen onto a cream signature marked with brown text bars.

items.name: Libpath Bay
items.depicts: A single wooden shelf section holding colourful gold-banded volumes and one leaning olive book, shown in narrow and wide widths.

items.name: Symbol Catalogue
items.depicts: A wooden three-by-three drawer chest on legs with brass pulls, two lower drawers slid open to reveal cream index stock.

items.name: Stack Climber
items.depicts: A tall angled wooden rolling ladder with pale rungs and grey iron rail hooks at the top and feet.

items.name: Thread Bobbin
items.depicts: A wooden bobbin wound with red thread, paying out a bright-tipped horizontal strand to the right.

items.name: Autoloader Cart
items.depicts: A two-tier grey metal book trolley on spoked wheels, loaded with colourful gold-banded volumes.

items.name: Dot-C Crates
items.depicts: Three stacked brown wooden shipping crates with diagonal slats, each stencilled with .C in cream lettering.

items.name: Linker Loom
items.depicts: A wooden frame loom strung with vertical red and blue warp threads, a grey heddle bar, and a yellow shuttle passing across.

items.name: Dot-A Archive
items.depicts: A wooden filing unit with a closed upper drawer above an open lower tray holding upright white and cream tabbed folders.

items.name: Banker's Desk Lamp
items.depicts: A classic green-shaded banker's desk lamp with a brass stem, a tiny yellow pull-chain pixel, and a dark wooden base.

items.name: Diamond Dependency
items.depicts: A framed dark pinboard with five pale nodes linked by crossing red, yellow, and brown threads.

items.name: Pthread Line
items.depicts: Two orange square endpoints joined by a sagging dotted brown line carrying a bright yellow pulse along its span.

items.name: Soname Plaque
items.depicts: A wooden aisle plaque inlaid with bright yellow brass lettering, shown in two text variants reading LIBDL and LIBZ.

items.name: Header Slip
items.depicts: A single cream index card with a red top rule, two olive-grey text lines, and a dark drop shadow.

items.name: Manpage Lectern
items.depicts: A wooden pedestal lectern supporting an open cream reference volume with grey text blocks on both pages.

items.name: Deprecation Stamp
items.depicts: A purple ink pad beside a tiered wooden rubber stamp hovering above a cream slip bearing a fresh purple impression.

items.name: Vendored Pile
items.depicts: A small uneven stack of four horizontal hardcover books in green, purple, and brown with cream page edges.

items.name: Legacy Changelog
items.depicts: An unrolled cream parchment scroll between two wooden rollers, showing three olive-grey lines of text with a red mark on the top line.

items.name: Symbol Inspector
items.depicts: A grey-rimmed magnifying glass with a wooden handle hovering over four olive-grey lines of text on a cream page.

items.name: Hash Pigeonholes
items.depicts: A wooden four-by-three pigeonhole cabinet with nine cubbies holding cream or white stacks of slips and three empty black slots.

items.name: Locale Globe
items.depicts: A small blue-and-green terrestrial globe mounted in a yellow brass meridian ring on a stepped wooden stand.

items.name: Reading Carrel
items.depicts: A wooden reading table holding a pale book and a teal box, paired with a tall-backed wooden chair on the right.

items.name: Errno Inkwell
items.depicts: A dark grey square ink bottle with a silver collar and a three-pixel pale yellow quill leading toward a detached yellow pixel at top right.

items.name: Fseek Ribbon
items.depicts: A crimson-bound book face with a cream panel and a bright yellow ribbon bookmark hanging past the bottom edge.

items.name: The Libc Codex
items.depicts: A heavy dark-brown leather codex with golden side clasps and a cream cover plate bearing two dark grey title bars.

items.name: AVL Balance
items.depicts: A yellow brass balance scale on a wooden base with two level brown weighing pans suspended by grey chains.

items.name: Timeout Glass
items.depicts: A wooden-framed glass hourglass with pale sand in the upper bulb and a fuller pile of bright yellow sand below.

items.name: Folio-Crowned Pager
items.depicts: A tiny square-bodied critter with dark eyes, corner ear-tabs, and an open miniature book balanced on its head, in tan, pale blue, and dusty rose variants.
